step1_analysis.description: A modified CMOS inverter with an internal transmission gate (XM3, XM4) inserted between the PMOS pull-up and NMOS pull-down networks. This topology limits short-circuit current and provides asymmetric drive strengths at nodes N1 and N2, making it useful for low-power delay cells or slew-rate control in mixed-signal circuits like quantizers.

paper_reference.title: A 0.5V <4μW CMOS Photoplethysmographic Heart-Rate Sensor IC Based on a Non-Uniform Quantizer

switching_threshold.description: Input voltage at which the output N1 crosses VDD/2.

sky130_expected.calculation: With VDD=1.8V, the pull-up for N1 is a single PMOS (W/L=10), while the pull-down is two series NMOS (effective W/L=5). Since NMOS mobility (270uA/V^2) is much higher than PMOS (50uA/V^2), the pull-down network is stronger, shifting the threshold slightly below VDD/2.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Calculated based on the mobility ratio and the series NMOS vs single PMOS pull-up for node N1.

power_consumption.description: Average power consumption of the cell at the reported 32kHz operating frequency.

sky130_expected.calculation: Dynamic power P = C*V^2*f. Assuming C_load = 20fF (N1+N2), V=1.8V, f=32kHz. P_dyn = 20e-15 * 3.24 * 32e3 ≈ 2nW. Short-circuit power adds ~1nW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Adjusted for 1.8V supply on SKY130. The paper's 4μW metric is for the entire sensor IC; a single delay cell consumes orders of magnitude less.

propagation_delay.description: Average time delay between input N0 and output N1 crossing VDD/2.

sky130_expected.calculation: t_pd ≈ C * VDD / (2 * I_avg). With I_avg ≈ 400μA and C=10fF, t_pd is in the tens of picoseconds.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Based on standard CMOS delay equations for SKY130 1.8V devices with 10fF load.

rise_time.description: Time for output N1 to transition from 10% to 90% of VDD.

sky130_expected.calculation: t_rise ≈ C * 0.8 * VDD / I_p. I_p ≈ 200μA, C=10fF -> t_rise ≈ 72ps.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Determined by the single PMOS pull-up strength and load capacitance.

fall_time.description: Time for output N1 to transition from 90% to 10% of VDD.

sky130_expected.calculation: t_fall ≈ C * 0.8 * VDD / I_n. I_n ≈ 600μA, C=10fF -> t_fall ≈ 24ps.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Determined by the series NMOS pull-down strength and load capacitance. Faster than rise time due to higher electron mobility.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure switching threshold, propagation delay, rise/fall times, and power consumption of the low-power inverter cell at 32kHz.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Low-power Inverter / Delay Cell Testbench
.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u

.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VIN N0 0 PULSE(0 1.8 1u 100p 100p 15u 31.25u)

XM1 N1 N0 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N2 N0 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 N1 N0 N2 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 N2 N0 N1 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}

* Load capacitance for realistic measurements
CL1 N1 0 10f
CL2 N2 0 10f

.control
  * DC Analysis for Switching Threshold
  dc VIN 0 1.8 0.01
  meas dc vth_switch find v(N0) when v(N1)=0.9
  print vth_switch
  
  * Transient Analysis for Delay and Power
  tran 10p 35u
  
  * Rise and Fall Times
  meas tran t_rise trig v(N1) val=0.18 rise=1 targ v(N1) val=1.62 rise=1
  meas tran t_fall trig v(N1) val=1.62 fall=1 targ v(N1) val=0.18 fall=1
  
  * Propagation Delays
  meas tran t_pd_hl trig v(N0) val=0.9 rise=1 targ v(N1) val=0.9 fall=1
  meas tran t_pd_lh trig v(N0) val=0.9 fall=1 targ v(N1) val=0.9 rise=1
  let t_pd = (t_pd_hl + t_pd_lh) / 2
  print t_rise t_fall t_pd
  
  * Average Power Consumption
  let inst_power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
  meas tran avg_power avg inst_power from=0 to=35u
  print avg_power
  
  quit
.endc
.end
